root_cause: Original protected release #5835 fixed historical per-source backfill fanout but its activeDispatches first skipped WAIT_EXTERNAL source records and then coalesced other sources of the same original obligationId. One unblocked historic source could therefore still enqueue a new event for an obligation with an independently proven provider/consent hard boundary.

evidence.source_code_condition: candidate.nextAction === WAIT_EXTERNAL was skipped per source before canonical obligation grouping

semantic_learning.cause: Filtering out WAIT_EXTERNAL candidates before grouping permitted other candidates for the same canonical obligation to create wakeup
semantic_learning.prevention_rule: When a registered original obligation contains any WAIT_EXTERNAL source, skip the whole owner group's backfill wakeup, retain every source in report.candidates and only resume after independently authorized provider readback.
